speaker: Raj
text: Oh, hey, Leonard. How was your day? Sheldon, how could you just sit there and whip that tail on me?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Bite me. Clever Leonard, they exploited my complete lack of interest in what you were doing.

speaker: Raj
text: You should thank us. When future generations try to determine why your relationship with Penny crashed and burned, this right here is the black box. What are you talking about? The date went fine.

speaker: Benny
text: It's coming. Squeeze him up. Dude, she said she wants to slow things down.

speaker: Raj
text: Okay, so she said she wants to slow things down. It's like saying, I'm really enjoying this meal, I'm going to slow down and savor it.

speaker: Raj
text: No, it's like, this fish tastes bad, so I'm gonna slow down and spit it out.

speaker: Benny
text: You being the fish.

speaker: Raj
text: I'm not the fish. Oh, really? Did you make a second date?

speaker: Benny
text: No, we sort of decided to wing it.

speaker: Raj
text: Oh, even I know that's lame.

speaker: Benny
text: Okay, alright, but let's assume your hypothesis. We went to dinner, we talked, we laughed, we kissed. Where did I possibly go wrong?

speaker: Raj
text: Think back, Leonard. The littlest things can set women off. Like, hey, the waitress is hot, I bet we could get her to come home with us. Or, how much does your mom weigh? I wanna know what I'm getting into.

speaker: Benny
text: I didn't say anything like that.

speaker: Raj
text: Good, because they don't work.

speaker: Benny
text: They also don't get it if you stare at them and hyperventilate. Sadly, that's my home run swing.

speaker: Raj
text: Look, everything went fine. I didn't even have to refer to my impromptu conversation starters. That woman across the hall is into me.

speaker: Benny
text: Let's go to the table.

speaker: Raj
text: Look at her reaction to the goodnight kiss. No change in respiration, pupils undilated, no flushing of the chest.

speaker: Benny
text: Nice close-up, by the way.

speaker: Raj
text: Interesting, her jaws are clenched, no tongue access. Clearly a bad sign amongst mating humans. It's not a bad sign, please. You might as well have been to a guana with no dewlap enlargement.

speaker: Benny
text: And the worst sign of all is you're here and not there.

speaker: Raj
text: I'm not there because I'm taking things slow. Which, by the way, compared to you guys, approaches warp speed. And take down that camera.

speaker: Benny
text: It was a lot more fun when you had no hope.
